entities.name: GTF2I
observations: Common variation in GTF2I has been investigated in healthy adults for socioemotional traits.

entities.name: rs13227433
observations: Common GTF2I polymorphism studied in 808 university students; AA genotype was associated with decreased threat-related amygdala reactivity.

entities.name: PMID:26853120
observations: Swartz et al., 2017: In 808 university students, GTF2I rs13227433 AA genotype predicted decreased threat-related amygdala response; mediation of genotype association with warmth facet of extraversion was seen in women, not men.

entities.name: GTF2I socioemotional association
observations: Healthy university-student sample (n=808): rs13227433 AA predicted lower threat-related amygdala reactivity; this mediated greater extraversion warmth in women, not men. Earlier work linked this allele to lower social anxiety.
